items.html: And we shall now explain how all the three phases begin to be corrected. And we say that it is simple that in the first three days, called the days of absorption, some lights and some sparks begin to enter the vessels. For it was already explained above that all the three phases were corrected little by little, and it was stated above that the lights, the sparks, and the vessels were all included and became three included in three, and they clothed the NHY of AA — Aba covers and clothes from the right side of AA, and Ima from the left side of AA. And we find that half of these three phases stand inside Aba, and their half inside Ima. And Aba gives them all to Ima, in the secret of the three days of absorption.
